svg.aria-label: SOMA overview. Warm-start: F answers the first turns. An adversarial soft prompt on the frozen G scores how robustly G still reproduces F on each warm-start turn. Localized LoRA fits G to F, weighted by this score. Gated serving: G takes over after a fidelity and locality check and serves from a compressed context; a drift monitor rolls back to F.
svg.text: one-time adaptation between turn 3 and turn 4 (steps 2–3)
drift detected at turn 8: roll back to F and refresh the warm-start state
